children.name: place
children.signature:
def place(
        self, customer: str, /, drink: str = "espresso",
        *extras: OrderLine, **notes: str,
    ) -> Order:
        order = Order(customer, [OrderLine(drink, 1), *extras], notes=notes)
        self.orders.append(order)
        self.fulfill(order)
        return order
